entities.summary: Paul Eltzbacher was a German legal scholar, professor, and author best known for his influential writings on anarchism and his later role as a right-wing nationalist theorist. Born into a Jewish family in Cologne, Prussian Rhineland, he made significant contributions to the legal understanding of political ideologies and was later considered a precursor of National Bolshevism.
